nodes.name: Door
nodes.notes: One door, named after the machine: POST /webhook/enrich-phones. Body {recordId} = a Hub launch row {Client, View, Tag} (the single Launch automation posts it); body {baseId, clientRecordId, table, view} = an event call. Answers 200 on receipt: a phone run is never waited on.

nodes.name: Stamp Running
nodes.notes: First thing after the fetch, ahead of every guard: the row carries this Execution ID and link from the moment the POST lands, so a refusal or a crash can always be read back on the row the Operator launched. Passes the record through, so Resolve Base reads fields.Client off it.

nodes.name: Resolve Base
nodes.notes: A launch row with no Client link asks for recMISSING and keeps going; Launch Params reads the answer defensively and refuses with the reason.

nodes.name: Launch OK?
nodes.notes: The refusal gate: Launch Params names a bad launch row instead of throwing; false means refused, and Build Refusal closes the row as Failed with the reason before a single phone credit is spent.

nodes.name: Columns OK?
nodes.notes: People must already carry what this Rootflow reads and does not own (first_name, last_name, Domain, Email, LinkedIn URL, Phone). Missing: refused by name on the launch row, before any provider is called.

nodes.name: Create Columns
nodes.notes: The phone lane this Rootflow owns, created on first use: Final Phone, Phone Provider, Phone Type, Phone Found At, Phone Status. It never touches a field it does not own.

nodes.name: Fetch Rows
nodes.notes: The view is the whole scope and the spend cap: only the people in it are looked up. Six fields only, so the parent stays flat at any list size.

nodes.name: Batch
nodes.notes: The memory law (ruled 2026-09-09): no execution grows with the list. 100 people a batch, each batch its own execution of this same workflow, counters accumulated in the launch row.

nodes.name: Log Run
nodes.notes: One Hub Automations row per run, upserted on Execution ID: the launch row the Operator fired, or its own row on an event call. Every batch accumulated into it; a refusal closes it Failed.

nodes.name: SQ Company Resolve
nodes.notes: Supersoniq REST resolve (companies/enrich, naked tier, has_phone filter, 5 a company): 0.5 credit a naked contact, so up to 2.5 a domain. One call per DISTINCT domain in the batch. No credential or an empty wallet is a logged skip, never a crash.

nodes.name: SQ Phone Unlock
nodes.notes: Supersoniq REST phone unlock by contact_id. 10 credits a phone (25 specialty) ONLY when a phone is on file; 404 is a free clean miss. This is the machine's main spend.

nodes.name: Ark Mobile Finder
nodes.notes: AI-Ark v2 mobile-phone-finder (Clay-compatible: HTTP 200 on a miss). 5 credits a found number, nothing on a miss.

nodes.name: LM Mobile Finder
nodes.notes: LeadMagic mobile-finder by work email; charged per found mobile. Out of credits (402) is classified as a skip, never an error.

nodes.name: PR Mobile Finder
nodes.notes: Prospeo enrich-person with enrich_mobile, the last tier. 10 credits a mobile FOUND, free on NO_MATCH.

nodes.name: Write Rows
nodes.notes: Ten rows a request, 200 ms apart, typecast on so a new provider mints its own choice on Phone Provider. Only the phone lane is written; Phone itself belongs to Enrich Contacts.

nodes.name: Log Batch
nodes.notes: The batch adds its slice to the run's one row (upsert on Execution ID); the parent writes the verdict after the last batch.

nodes.name: Contact Door
nodes.notes: NOT the Rootflow. The Hub contact door held for the lead handlers (Enrich & Qualify new lead from PlusVibe, Email Bison and Alta all POST {recordId, signature_phone?} here and put the number on their Slack cards). One Hub Prospects row, answered synchronously, writes phone + Phone Source there. Unchanged on purpose; retiring it or moving it out is the Operator's call.

nodes.name: Fetch Company
nodes.notes: The company Prospect row carries the synced Conversation Thread, where the lead's own signature block (and its phone) survives.

nodes.name: SQ Resolve
nodes.notes: Supersoniq REST resolve (companies/enrich, naked tier, has_phone filter). Max 2.5 credits (5 naked contacts).

nodes.name: Ready?
nodes.notes: Contact and Client are both required. A launch row missing either never spends a call; it goes straight to the log with the reason.

nodes.name: Launch Run?
nodes.notes: Same execution, two exits: a launch run updates its launch row; a caller run answers the webhook and writes its own log row.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: $('Build Launch Log').first().json.Errors === 0, status: $('Build Launch Log').first().json.Status, target: $('Build Launch Log').first().json.Target } }}

nodes.name: Launch Respond
nodes.notes: Closes the launch webhook. The launch row already carries the full verdict; this is just the acknowledgement.
